source_passage: Financial-services software / fintech (wealth, trading, market data, super administration) — among the highest data-sensitivity sectors. Confirmed high-severity recent breach: a stolen GitHub credential was used to access the OneVue production environment (detected/contained 11 May 2024, reported to ACSC 13 May 2024, disclosed to ASX). Although the investigation found limited data impact (test files, PII of 20 individuals), the incident sits squarely in regulated financial software and Iress is a custodian of ~A$130bn of annual wealth transaction data (FundsFlow). Potential change of control (Blackstone/Thoma Bravo talks) adds an underwriting-relevant transition window. May 2024 GitHub credential theft → unauthorised access to OneVue production environment; reported to ACSC, disclosed to ASX Investigation completed Jul 2024: PII of 20 individuals (OneVue employees/clients) found in test files; IoCs shared with ACSC; broader production/client data not impacted Public incident notifications confirming the GitHub issue reached the OneVue production environment containing client data Former subsidiary / breach environment: OneVue Holdings (fund registry/super admin, acquired ~A$115m 2020/2021); super-registry portion later divested to Praemium Data/analytics partner: Quantium (powers the FundsFlow product) — indirect link to Woolworths (Quantium's ~75-80% owner) Technology partner: Thoughtworks (May 2026, wealth-platform modernisation) Customer/partner: HostPlus with Industry Fund Services (scaled digital advice) Prospective acquirers: Blackstone and Thoma Bravo (early-stage buyout talks, no deal confirmed) External auditor: Ernst & Young (EY); share registry: Computershare Competitors: SS&C, Bloomberg, iPipeline, Intelliflo, Sage (lower-confidence)
